protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real published CWE-284. CVE.org CVE-2026-41856 is state=PUBLISHED (VMware CNA, not rejected). Vendor https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41856 and GHSA-phxq-526m-79px (withdrawn_at=null) state that @Controller data-fetcher annotation detection can miss annotations on type-hierarchy methods, and with Spring Security plus @EnableMethodSecurity those missed annotations can skip authorization. Source-to-sink in-tree: HandlerMethodParameter.getParameterAnnotations() merges interface parameter annotations collected by getInterfaceParameterAnnotations() only when isOverrideFor(candidate) succeeds; the generic fallback compared this.method.getParameterTypes()[i] by identity to ResolvableType.forMethodParameter(candidate, i, this.method.getDeclaringClass()).resolve(). On bridge-erased generic interfaces resolve() can fail to yield the concrete raw Class, so the interface method is rejected and its annotations (including any used for authorization) are omitted. Direct fix 63a89ed1379be646822dca9779b15dbf2ce45839 changes that call to toClass(); issue gh-1469 and the added HandlerMethodTests case (Long/Object erased parameters on GenericInterface) document the same matching failure.
